note: Graded at the end of every turn by .referee/scripts/audit.mjs. Each rule passes, fails, or is n/a when its trigger never happened. Add a rule for every mistake you never want twice. "plain" is the short sentence the user sees after each message when the rule fails.

rules.plain: started editing before loading the skill this request needed
rules.why: If the router named a skill for the request, the agent loaded it before its first file edit in that turn.

rules.plain: opened a PR without the PR-writing skill
rules.why: PRs follow the repo's title and description rules.

rules.plain: opened a PR without an independent review
rules.why: The configured independent reviewer ran before the PR was opened.

rules.plain: opened a PR without proving the checks pass
rules.why: The agent ran the proving checks, with evidence, before opening a PR.

rules.plain: applied review feedback without checking it
rules.why: Review findings were verified and triaged, not applied blindly.

rules.plain: said it was ready without running the readiness check
rules.why: When ship ran, the agent computed readiness instead of claiming it.
Merging is the human's call unless they said "full send".
Skipping git hooks skips the repo's own checks.

rules.plain: kept trying moves the referee blocks
rules.why: An agent that keeps hitting the guard is working around a rule instead of fixing the cause.
